Games is cut off at the right edge with no arrow or fade; the outer section scroller sees no overflow (sw 716 = cw 716) so its arrows never appear. A user on the iPad has no visible way to reach Games from the strip.

title: Mangaka takes ~3 s to render on the dense account (reads and groups every book on each open)
detail: Navigating Home → #/mangaka with 1,107 books took ~2.9 s until the DOM settled (Books vault 1.5 s, Anime 1.1 s, Overview 0.8 s). The page queries the whole Books module, groups by author and computes works/volumes/chapters per author in the sort comparator (worksOf/mkVols/mkChapters re-filter per comparison), every paint and on every search keystroke.
evidence: eval timing: {'#/mangaka':2925ms,'#/books':1554,'#/anime':1074,'#/matrix':792,'#/shrine':882}; js/modules/books.js:1651 (full query), 1600-1603 (sort comparator recomputing worksOf per comparison)
fix: Precompute per-author aggregates once per filter change (a map name→{works, vols, ch}) and sort on the cached values; cache the grouped rows between visits keyed on the vault's change counter.
rootCause: Per-comparison recomputation in the sort (O(n log n × works)) plus an unbounded module read on every open.

title: No link out to the title's AniList/VNDB page, and nowhere to keep 'where I watch/read it' (QoL)
detail: The editor shows 'Linked to AniList' and knows anilistId/malId/vndbId, but only Games has an outbound link ('View on Steam ↗', games.js:333). Anime/Books/VN have no 'Open on AniList/VNDB' and no personal 'Where I'm watching/reading' URL. Proposal for the watch link: a manual-layer field `links: [{label, url}]` (or a single `watchUrl`) added in mediadb.normalise (js/core/mediadb.js:542, sanitised to http(s) only, no index so no DB version bump — like physical.seriesTotal), preserved in merge() beside notes/tags (mediadb.js ~1062: `inc.links = old.links.length ? old.links : inc.links`), unioned in foldLocal (mediadb.js:934) and covered by materialJSON automatically; never pushed (invariant 13 payloads stay status/progress/score) and excluded from search (71). UI: an input on 'Your layer' with a 'Use clipboard' helper; a '▶ Watch' / '📖 Read' button beside '+1 ep' on the card hover row, the Spotlight hero and the editor header, opening in a new tab (rel=noopener). The provider page link (AniList/VNDB) can be derived from the ids and shown on the Record tab.
evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-layer-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-record-mac.png; grep: only js/modules/games.js:57,333 build an outbound title URL
fix: Add the field to normalise/merge/foldLocal as above, a URL input in the shared editor's personal layer (KOS.mediaEditors), and a Watch/Read action in medview's card and hero.

title: Books status rail counts the whole module while the grid shows one lens ('All 1107' beside '738 series')
detail: On Books (Digital lens, the default) the rail reads All 1107 / In progress 221 / … while the toolbar count says 738 series and the grid holds 738. Switching to Physical Vault keeps the same rail numbers. Clicking a status therefore shows fewer titles than its count promises.
evidence: eval on #/books: rail 'All 1107','In progress 221'…; vault.count '738 series'; lens 'Digital:true'
fix: Pass the active lens predicate to filterRail (e.g. filterRail(module, onChange, {filter: lensFn})) and count only rows that pass it; recount when the lens changes.
rootCause: js/modules/medview.js:1704-1712 reload() counts `KOS.mediadb.query({module})` — every row of the module — with no knowledge of the Books lens set in js/modules/books.js:1131.

title: Ordering a tied tier while the Shrine is filtered to one medium erases the hand-set rank of every other medium's titles in that tier
detail: Shrine 'Set order' builds the dialog from the FILTERED favourites. On drop it stores only the visible titles' keys as the whole tier's order, so the other media's titles in the same score lose their rank and fall to the end in 'All media'. Reproduced: tier 10 ordered under All media (7 keys stored); switched to Anime (tier shows 3 titles), moved one title -> stored list for '10' is now 3 keys; the 4 non-anime titles' positions are gone. 'Reset to date enshrined' under a filter likewise wipes the whole tier for all media, with no confirm and no undo.
evidence: eval repro on slot 17 (s1len 7 -> s2len 3); js/modules/shrine.js:809-813 (onDrop stores only list rows), 827-829 (reset, no confirm/undo), 972 (tiers from filtered favourites); js/core/media.js:580-596 setTierOrder replaces sh.order[k] whole
fix: On drop, merge: take the stored order for the tier, replace the visible titles' slots in place with the new sequence, keep the hidden titles where they were (or only offer Set order under All media). Make Reset confirm (or offer Undo via toast) and reset only the visible titles when filtered.
rootCause: tier order is one flat list per score, but the dialog edits a filtered subset and writes it back as the whole list

title: Wishlist priority can only be set by HTML5 mouse drag: no keyboard path, no grip in Want to buy, unreliable on iPad touch (bypasses KOS.ui.reorder)
detail: The Wishlist's 'Priority order' is a hand-ranked list ('Drag a row to set its priority'), but it is implemented with native draggable rows (dragstart/dragover/dragend) instead of the shared KOS.ui.reorder (⠿ handle, Space/↑↓, announced) that invariant 89a requires for every hand-ranked list. In the Want to buy tab the row's lead is the simulate checkbox, so there is no visible handle at all; the item editor has no priority field. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot reorder; on iPad (touch, installed app) native HTML drag needs a long-press and fights scrolling.
evidence: js/modules/wishlist.js:892-903 (draggable + hint text), 997-1002 (checkbox lead / aria-hidden grip), 1124-1140 (enableDrag HTML5); editor fields 700-727 have no priority
fix: Use KOS.ui.reorder on the list with a ⠿ grip button per row (beside the checkbox in Want to buy), committing through reorder(status, ids).
rootCause: wishlist predates the shared reorder primitive

title: After Mark purchased, the Money confirmation and its 'View in Transactions' action are overwritten at once by the Collection handoff toast

Reproduced: after the click #toast reads only 'Added to Collection as planned.' The user never sees what was added to Money or gets the link; there is also no Undo for a purchase that wrote to Money and the Collection.
evidence: eval on slot 17 after plan.buy-go: toast 'Added to Collection as planned.'; js/modules/wishlist.js:1095-1098 then 1109-1120; js/core/ui.js:72-81 (toast replaces textContent, no queue)
